$schema: clone-website extraction artifact — consumed by scripts/emit-design-system.ts
name: Reflect

extraction.method: Playwright computed-style inspection, stylesheet inspection, interaction sweep, public asset inventory, and 1440px/768px/390px captures
extraction.evidence: Original captures and section crops are retained in docs/design-references/reflect-app. Values below come from live computed styles or first-party CSS rules.
extraction.note: A near-black violet canvas carries softly glowing lavender surfaces, with Aeonik display typography and a single electric-purple action tone.

--bg.reason: Continuous page canvas declared on the live body element.

--surface.reason: Lifted glass and demo-panel base calibrated from the live rgba surface stack.

--surface-warm.reason: Quiet violet inset tone behind cards and modal treatments.
--surface-warm.source: derived from live glass layers over #030014

--fg.reason: Primary button and foreground copy color from live styles.

--fg-2.source: live body typography and section header inspection

--muted.reason: Hero and section supporting copy tier.

--border.reason: Glass panel, input, and hairline treatment.

--border-soft.reason: Subtle grid and internal divider tier.
--border-soft.source: derived from live 0.08–0.12 white grid rules

--accent.reason: Purple primary action and black-hole glow core.
--accent.source: live hero and CTA visual inspection

--accent-on.reason: Live button foreground tone over purple action surfaces.

--accent-hover.reason: Brighter lavender preserves the live luminous hover hierarchy.
--accent-hover.source: derived from hero glow and hover treatment

--accent-active.reason: Saturated purple visible in animated diagram and selection states.
--accent-active.source: live research radar and AI selection CSS

--success.reason: Emerald copy in the live AI interaction callout.

--warn.reason: Warm semantic tier chosen to stay legible against the violet canvas.
--warn.source: semantic mapping; no decorative warning state in page scope

--danger.reason: Accessible red-pink semantic tier for future error feedback.
--danger.source: semantic mapping; no destructive action in page scope

--font-display.reason: Live section headings use the downloaded AeonikPro medium face.

--font-body.reason: Live body, controls, navigation, and labels use Inter V.
--font-body.source: live body and button computed font-family

--font-mono.value: ui-monospace, "SF Mono", Menlo, Monaco, Consolas, monospace
--font-mono.reason: Keyboard shortcut treatment and note UI support a compact monospace fallback.

--text-xs.reason: Keyboard labels, icon captions, and dense UI tier.
--text-xs.source: live hero tooltip and AI animation stylesheet

--text-sm.reason: Live navigation, badge, and button size.

--text-lg.reason: Footer newsletter and compact display tier.

--leading-body.reason: 16px body copy renders at 24px line height.

--leading-tight.reason: 72px hero heading uses 80px leading; section headings preserve the same tight rhythm.

--tracking-display.reason: Aeonik display optical tightening inferred from the live 72px title silhouette.

--space-1.reason: Micro control and icon gap unit.

--space-2.reason: Button padding and small internal gap.

--space-3.source: live AI answer and menu styles

--space-5.reason: Header and phone horizontal safety gutter.

--space-6.reason: Feature card and glass panel inset.

--space-8.reason: Large card inset and section-grid gap.
--space-8.source: live integrations item and research card CSS

--section-y-desktop.reason: Repeated desktop section rhythm in the live page.

--section-y-tablet.reason: Intermediate compression observed between 1440px and 768px inspections.

--section-y-phone.reason: Mobile capture preserves generous visual pauses between content groups.

--radius-sm.reason: Live action button and input corner value.

--radius-md.reason: AI menu and answer panel corner value.

--radius-lg.reason: Hero video and AI showcase outer frame radius.

--radius-pill.reason: Badges, play control, and pill navigation capsule.
--radius-pill.source: live hero badge and header navigation inspection

--elev-flat.reason: The page relies on luminous borders rather than conventional elevation.

--elev-ring.reason: Faithful hairline glass ring used across live panels.

--elev-raised.reason: Deep but quiet lift for modal or interactive panel states.
--elev-raised.source: derived from live hero and modal layers

--focus-ring.reason: Visible keyboard treatment mapped to source lavender glow.
--focus-ring.source: accent derived from live hero glow

--motion-fast.reason: Live hero and button transitions use 0.3s.

--motion-base.reason: Footer and content link transitions use 0.45s.

--ease-standard.source: live button, video, and lazy media CSS

--container-max.reason: The four-card feature strip is explicitly 1200px wide.

--container-gutter-desktop.reason: Desktop header logo and CTA sit 72px from the 1440px frame edge.

--container-gutter-phone.reason: Source header retains a 20px horizontal inset at phone width.
